seo_title: AI Web Accessibility Agent: Automate WCAG Compliance Now
seo_desc: Avoid fines. Our AI Agent audits your codebase, rewrites the DOM, and adds ARIA labels automatically to ensure full accessibility compliance.
author_pitch: Pushing a project to production and moving it from a staging subdomain to the root domain is stressful enough without a technical audit halting the launch. I designed this AI system to automate code remediation and take that burden off your shoulders.
title: Accessibility AI Agent: Avoid Fines and Automate Your WCAG Compliance
body:
Is your B2B platform ready for the new European Accessibility Act, or are you facing massive fines?

Adapting thousands of lines of code to meet WCAG 2.1 standards is not just tedious; it is a financial sinkhole. Development teams waste weeks injecting ARIA attributes, tweaking contrasts, and restructuring semantics instead of building new features, causing strategic delays and thousands of euros in non-productive hours.

The trap of magical accessibility widgets

Installing a visual overlay plugin does not alter the source code, and screen readers still fail, exposing your business to legal lawsuits anyway. True accessibility cannot be patched with a widget; it must be embedded in the core of the DOM.

Our solution: Semantic Remediation AI Agent

At Lanza Estudio, we have integrated an AI Agent that connects to your repository or staging environment. Before you push your project to the main root domain in production, our AI scans the architecture, detects accessibility roadblocks, and generates automated Pull Requests with the exact HTML/React code to fix them without breaking your design.

  1. Dynamic DOM Tree: The AI injects precise 'aria-label' tags and 'roles' into complex interactive components.
  2. Contrast and Predictive CSS: Rewrites color variables in your stylesheets to guarantee the 4.5:1 ratio without ruining your UI.
  3. Keyboard Navigation: Automatically generates logical 'tabindex' attributes for modals and dropdown menus.
  4. Generative Alt Text: Analyzes your platform's images and writes contextual descriptions that are perfect for SEO and screen readers.

The Real Impact on Your B2B Company

  • Blind regulatory compliance: Dodge penalties of up to €100,000 by guaranteeing WCAG 2.1 and ADA standards automatically.
  • Massive savings in QA: Eliminate manual audits and reduce accessibility testing time by 85% in every sprint.
  • SEO market expansion: A semantically perfect codebase not only helps people with disabilities but also skyrockets Google crawling and rankings.
